verdict.rationale: Numeral's API lets developers create and categorize products for tax purposes via POST `/tax/products`. Calculations take an address plus a set of products, and AI product classification is offered, so line items are taxed according to their product category. Missing for 10: the actual tax-category list (e.g. SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods) is not documented in the evidence, per-jurisdiction taxability behavior for each category is not shown, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
